LanguageData.Grechka_SoundMuffler_Building.label: sound muffler
LanguageData.Grechka_SoundMuffler_Building.descriptio: Suppresses sounds originating inside its radius: machinery, gunshots, footsteps, voices and other local effects. Works through walls. Each device has its own adjustable radius of 1 to 30 cells, default 12. Requires 50 W; sounds return when unpowered, switched off or broken down. Music, interface sounds and sounds without a map source are preserved.
